sections.h2: Which Burgaw office do I call about a Pender bill or a value?
sections.html:
Both property tax offices operate from 803 S. Walker Street in Burgaw. Tax Administration keeps the appraisal and listing records. Tax Collections sends the bills and takes the money. The county's own wording is that collections is responsible only for collecting, and that questions about listing, billing and assessed values belong with the assessor's side.

  • Value or record questions: the assessment line, (910) 259-1221.
  • Payments and balances: Tax Collections, (910) 259-1222, or P.O. Box 1047, Burgaw, NC 28425 by mail.
  • Hours listed by the county: weekdays from eight in the morning until five.

Pender is unusual because not every town sends its bill through the county. Collections handles the county's levy plus Burgaw, Watha, St. Helena and Atkinson. Surf City and Topsail Beach run their own billing, and their real and personal property taxes fall due September 1 as well. A coastal house can therefore carry a county bill and a town bill.

sections.h2: What changed in the 2026 Pender revaluation?
sections.html:
Every real property parcel was repriced to its market value as of January 1, 2026. The county's previous effective date was January 1, 2019, which means seven years passed between the two.

Commissioners adopted a resolution in 2023 moving Pender to a four-year cycle, so after 2026 the county plans to revalue again every four years. State law alone only demands an eighth-year reappraisal, per G.S. 105-286. Ask Tax Administration for the next scheduled date.

Milestones the county printed for this cycle:

  • Notices of changed value mailed in late March 2026.
  • Board of Equalization and Review opened April 13, 2026.
  • County page told owners they had until December 31, 2026 to appeal.
  • First bills carrying the new values mailed in August 2026.

The county keeps stressing that a revaluation sets worth, not the bill. Rates come later, set by the commissioners and town boards, normally by July. Treat any figure you hear before then as a guess.

sections.h2: How do I contest a Pender value?
sections.html:
Use the 2026 Tax Appeal Form. It can be filled out online, printed and mailed to Pender County Tax Department, P.O. Box 67, Burgaw, NC 28425, or handed in at the Walker Street counter.

The county lays out three steps. First check the property record card for wrong square footage, features or condition, using the public access site. Second, compare your value with recent sales through the county's sales comparison tool. Third, if the record is right and the number still looks high, ask the Board of Equalization and Review for a hearing and wait for its written result.

The county is blunt about grounds. An appeal has to be about value, and a big jump or a feared tax increase does not count as a reason. Strong files usually include:

  • comparable sales dated before January 1, 2026
  • photographs or plans showing condition and upgrades
  • a recent fee appraisal from a purchase or refinance, if you have one

A losing owner can go on to the state Property Tax Commission by written notice a month after the county board mails its ruling (G.S. 105-290).

sections.h2: What is the Pender payment calendar?
sections.html:
Bills go out in late August, the debt is due September 1, and nothing extra is added through January 5. The collections page says interest starts January 6.

Dates printed on the Pender Tax Collections page
WhenEvent
January 1 to 31Personal property listing
Late AugustBills mailed, before September 1
September 1Real estate and personal property due
January 5Last day to avoid interest, penalties and legal remedies
January 6Interest starts: 2% for January, then 3/4 of 1% monthly
First Wednesday in MarchUnpaid real estate taxes listed as delinquent

Vehicles on the registration cycle follow other dates. The statewide interest rule is in G.S. 105-360.

You can pay by eCheck online, by phone, at the counter, or in the box outside the building. A Postal Service postmark counts, and a business meter stamp does not. Early payers can write "prepayment" plus the parcel number on a check before the bill arrives. Installment schedules are possible while no legal action is pending.

sections.h2: Does Pender have homestead relief for older or disabled owners?
sections.html:
North Carolina runs three programs for primary residences, and an owner is limited to one. Pender owners file with the county assessor on Form AV-9, and the state form tells counties to accept filings through June 1.

  • The age-or-disability exclusion subtracts $25,000 or half the home's value, whichever is higher. The state prints $38,800 as the 2026 income ceiling (NCDOR form).
  • The veteran exclusion takes $45,000 off for a qualifying disabled veteran, with no age or income test.
  • The circuit breaker limits the tax bill to 4% of income, or 5% for incomes up to 150% of the ceiling, and defers whatever is left over.

Read the details at G.S. 105-277.1 and G.S. 105-277.1C. Because deferred tax becomes a lien that comes due on a sale, ask the Pender assessor whether the house you are listing has any.

sections.h2: What if a Pender payment bounces or runs late?
sections.html:
A returned check or failed online payment adds a fee of 10% or $25, whichever is greater, under G.S. 105-357(b)(2) as the county cites it, plus any interest and penalty. The county declares the receipt void and wants cash, a money order or certified funds to fix it.

Collections says it works the full range of remedies the general statutes allow, and its page reports a combined collection rate of 97.23% for the year closed June 30, 2025. In plain terms, nearly every bill is paid, and the office follows up on the rest.

  • Delinquent real estate taxes are listed on the first Wednesday of March.
  • The last interest-free day is January 5, so a payment dated January 6 already carries the 2% charge.
  • The county adds that all information on its collections pages can change, so confirm any date with the office.

Unpaid tax can end in a foreclosure sale at the courthouse door, and G.S. 105-374 lets the owner redeem before confirmation. Contact the office long before that point.

sections.h2: What should I settle about Pender taxes before the closing table?
sections.html:
The year's lien rides with the land (G.S. 105-355), so your closing attorney will order a payoff and take it from your proceeds.

  • Learn whether a town bills the parcel in addition to the county.
  • Look for a delinquent balance on the March list.
  • Verify that monthly prepayments reached the right account.
  • Ask about any deferral lien from a relief program.

If you sell ahead of the September 1 due date, the buyer and you still need to agree on who covers that year. Owners who are behind and in a hurry can request cash offers, then compare each against the net after the payoff the collector quotes.

faqs.q: Where is the Pender County tax office?
faqs.a: 803 S. Walker Street in Burgaw. The county lists weekday hours and an outside drop box for payments after closing time.

faqs.q: What happened to the appeal window for the 2026 revaluation?
faqs.a: The county's page told owners they had until December 31, 2026. Confirm any later status with the tax department at (910) 259-1221.

faqs.q: Which Pender towns send their own tax bills?
faqs.a: Surf City and Topsail Beach bill and collect their own real and personal taxes. The county collector handles the county plus Burgaw, Watha, St. Helena and Atkinson.
Under the 2023 resolution, the cycle is every four years from the 2026 date. Ask the tax office to confirm the next effective date.

faqs.q: Does Pender allow installment payments of tax?
faqs.a: Yes, while no legal action is open on the account. Call before the bill turns delinquent, since the office says the window shrinks afterward.
